issues.title: Let the merchant choose whether a new partner rate applies to existing customers
issues.body:
**What.** When the merchant changes the rate of a partner who has customers, a dialog asks where the new rate applies:

- **All customers** (selected by default): every current customer of the partner pays the new rate from the next payment.
- **New customers only**: the current customers keep their rate; only customers brought from now on pay the new rate.

The partner's history records the choice.

**Why.** Decided on 29 Oct 2026: the market applies a new rate to all customers, and so does our level 1. With the dialog, the client no longer has to answer our question 1 of 23 Oct.

**Acceptance.** A partner has 3 customers at 5%. The merchant sets 7% and keeps the default: the next payment of each of the 3 customers pays the partner 7%. With "New customers only", the 3 customers still pay 5%.

issues.title: Show the date of the next monthly payout on the partner page
issues.body: Partners are paid monthly, on the 5th. The partner page shows no date. Show the date of the next payout above the balance.

issues.title: Export the commissions of a month as CSV
issues.body: The merchant needs the commissions of a month as a CSV file for the accountant: partner, customer, payment, rate, amount.
